new_claims: For every m <= N-R on the explicit false equation sum b_i = N+1, an (R+m)-fold finite difference satisfies all Run-84 product-feature source constraints.
Every such matrix has nonzero public anchor and rank at most m(R+m+1).
For fixed free coordinates there are 2^(N-R-m) distinct projective anchor-sensitive directions.
The matrices are publicly polynomial-time constructible using O((R+m)^2) applications of the existing linear partial-assignment update maps; exponential support enumeration is unnecessary.
The corresponding rank-mask public character has magnitude at least q^(-r*m(R+m+1)); the explicit family supplies a squared spectral-mass lower tail of at least 2^(N-R-m) q^(-2r*m(R+m+1)).
Escaping this particular generalized finite-difference construction solely by feature count requires m > N-R; this is not a sufficiency theorem for security.
